name: Peter Franchot
subject: Endorsement Alert: Mayor Calvin Washington
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I’m humbled to have received the endorsement of Forest Heights Mayor Calvin Washington! For years, Calvin has served our communities in more ways than one. As a military veteran, police officer, town council member, and Mayor, he’s been a consummate public servant who every day is focused on delivering results for his neighbors. He’s the kind of leader we need more of at the local level, and I’m honored to get his support.
Calvin, thank you for your trust and friendship. As Governor, I look forward to partnering with you to secure a stronger future for Forest Heights and all of Maryland. From making critical investments in 21st century infrastructure to create 100,000 new jobs, to achieving statewide 5G, to lowering the costs of healthcare and housing, we’re going to deliver the results that Marylanders deserve.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/calvinwashingtonendorsement?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/calvinwashingtonendorsement?amount=20.22]
This latest endorsement follows a long line of recent major endorsement announcements that add to the growing strength of our inclusive, statewide coalition of support. I’ve already received more endorsements from current and former elected officials and labor unions than any other candidate for Governor, and we have even more announcements to come!
Fresh off the heels of this latest endorsement alert, will you chip in to power our movement to victory? We’re looking to raise $2,325 to ensure we have the resources needed to keep firing on all cylinders in the final weeks of this primary race.
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/calvinwashingtonendorsement?amount=10]
CHIP IN $20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/calvinwashingtonendorsement?amount=20.22]
CHIP IN $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/calvinwashingtonendorsement?amount=50]
CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/calvinwashingtonendorsement?amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/calvinwashingtonendorsement]
Recent polls have confirmed that our people-powered movement is the frontrunner in this crowded field – and with your critical support, I have no doubt that we can pull ahead even further.
As Governor, I’ll take much-needed steps to combat the student debt crisis, invest in the next generation of internet connectivity, lower the costs of healthcare and housing, and so much more. Together, we can deliver on these concrete points of progress, and redefine the promise and possibility of state government in the years to come.
Our people-powered movement would not be possible without grassroots supporters like you. Any amount you can spare, whether large or small, will make a critical difference in the fight to secure a stronger future for Maryland. Thank you,

name: Candace Owens
subject: Roe v. Wade is dead, but the fight for life is just beginning.Here’s how we win >>
body:
More than 20 million Black babies were killed through abortion since 1973.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zs9ov53d6bccqf3dh7t1rrioajjn2itti15g4bio_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpjm2o74cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfcd5jespbctb4mhg64o346qpjacbmc1h78p30meq39c5ge4pbfc30mpp64cr0s3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor1cr661p78phmcipmcdtgmlin49fg)
---
| | | | | | | | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z2kpi2qilebo9r0b4njja7h6ni0d1vo8htdbnhj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpjm2o74cph2bs)
---
| Fellow Patriot,
This week, a leak showed the _Supreme Court is ready to overturn Roe v. Wade_...ending one of the greatest injustices in American history.
_No one_ understands the horrors of abortion more than the Black Americans...with **_more than 20 million Black babies killed_** through abortion since 1973.
But BLEXIT recognizes that ending _Roe v. Wade is NOT_ the end of our fight to protect life.
**We need to rebuild a culture of courage, personal responsibility, and respect for life in our communities.**
BLEXIT is doing tough work in our communities every day...and showcasing the _tremendous power_ of traditional American values:
* We believe that Black Americans have **unlimited potential to achieve the American Dream.**

* We know that our **nation’s values empower every one of us** , regardless of race.

Buddy Carter Gives Greater Georgia and Kelly Loeffler's Efforts a Shoutout on Fox News May 10, 2022 - == | == | | | | Loeffler: Biden must change course to preempt food shortage April 25, 2022 - == "In America, the availability of everyday goods such as groceries and gasoline is generally a given. Even in 2020, amid the fallout of a pandemic, well-documented shortages were relatively short-lived. But as the economy recovered heading into 2021, the shift in Washington toward Democratic policies may now make hunger pangs familiar in a way unseen since the Great Depression. While America is the world's breadbasket, reliance on Russian and Ukrainian wheat, barley, fertilizer, and, most of all, energy has made every mouthful cost more, as have increased regulations and taxes on our farmers here at home. Russia and Ukraine == 25% of the world's wheat, and Russia exports 20% of the world's natural gas supply, both vital to the food supply chain. Russian President Vladimir Putin's invasion has disrupted these exports and left the world in a precarious position. A recent article in Parade == basically every food as at risk of being in short supply in 2022, from eggs and dairy to produce and meat, but then laughably blamed climate change as one of the key causes. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmm8j8nfl4thpdj4m2qrppiffc3b481mph40u0qo_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpjm6or2c5h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0p0bpv6rua5qddleir0ck1kk7ssddknlhpit8pg_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpjm6or2c5h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
Join the McSwain for Governor team as we knock doors and make calls to help elect Bill McSwain, this Saturday 5/13! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/billmcswain/tomorrow-mcswain-for-governor-phone-banking-8989417?e=b1ec95759b)

| |

| |
##
Bill McSwain for Governor: Final Volunteer Day of Action Is On Saturday!
May 12, 2022 Good morning, McSwain supporters!

**Saturday, May 14,** we will have our final volunteer Day of Action!

We plan on knocking on doors in Bill's house county of Chester County!

If there is inclement weather, we will be**calling voters** in Chester County at the Chester County Republican Committee HQ.
---
|
---
| _The Day of Action schedule is as follows_ : **Date:** Saturday, May 14, 9:00AM - 2:00PM

**Address:** 15 S Church Street, West Chester, PA, 19382

**Parking Information:** Street parking is available

**9:00AM:** Meet at Chester County GOP Headquarters, 15 S Church Street, West Chester, PA, 19382

**9:00AM -10:00AM:** We will share instructions on door-knocking and phone banking and how to talk to voters. We will distribute lists of republican voters for our outreach efforts. Bill will be there to give his message to volunteers on how important their outreach efforts are!

**Note:** If you arrive after 10:00AM and miss the instructions, we will have a staffer at the office to assist you all day, 10:00AM-2:00pm.

**10:00AM-2:00PM:** Door knocking and phone-banking! We will head out to neighborhoods in Chester County to knock on doors. You will be given a list of republican households to visit. In the case of inclement weather, we will stay inside at Chester County GOP HQ and make phone calls.

_Donuts, coffee, and water will be available. _

Please email me at [Derek@billmcswain.com](mailto:derek@billmcswain.com?subject=I%20am%20attending%20the%205%2F7%20%20volunteer%20day%20of%20action%20&body=I%20am%20attending%20the%20volunteer%20day%20of%20action%20on%20behalf%20of%20Bill%20McSwain%20for%20Governor%20on%20Saturday%2C%20May%207%20at%209am) to let us know we can count on you for tomorrow!

Can't make it to Chester County? If you would like to make phone calls for Bill in another county, please reach out and let us know what county and we will send you a list and some instructions!

We look forward to seeing you on Saturday and appreciate your time!
Thank you,

Derek Rockey
Field Director
Bill McSwain for Governor

Life on a farm takes dedication, resiliency, and being okay with getting your hands dirty.

| [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45233940/345047372/-1995343361?refcode=abd_em_fr_2021.10.04_bX_logo_x__f1_s1_c1__header&amount=25&utm_campaign=abd_em_fr_2022.05.12_b1_rural2-brad_x_f1_s1_c1__ac&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMmNlNDc1ZS0xZGQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZjomtJgcxk5TiimJcob14YYs2JxFhW3Fk0SYwqZfxlA=)

Team,

I wanted to write to you today about something that isn’t on cable news. Fair warning – if you live in a big city, when you hear this, you might just choke on your oat juice.

Here it is: Rural America is just as important as any big city folk. In fact, Rural America is critical to defeating this new “wackadoodle” wave of extremist legislators taking over our democracy. Rural America matters.

But before I get started, if you don’t have time to read this entire email, would you consider chipping in $5 to help me defeat a Trump-endorsed wackadoodle with deep pockets full of dark money?

You can donate here: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brad-pfaff-for-rural-america](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45233944/345047376/-774467154?refcode=ABD_EM_FR_2022.05.12_b1_rural2-brad_X_F1_S1_C1__ac&amount=5&utm_campaign=abd_em_fr_2022.05.12_b1_rural2-brad_x_f1_s1_c1__ac&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMmNlNDc1ZS0xZGQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZjomtJgcxk5TiimJcob14YYs2JxFhW3Fk0SYwqZfxlA=)**

To some of us, especially those of us who live in Wisconsin’s 3rd Congressional District, Rural America is _more_ important than anywhere else. I know this because I was raised right here, in rural Wisconsin on a dairy farm.

I met my wife here. That’s where we’ve raised our kids and it’s where my family has been dairy farming since they came to this country in the 1800’s.

Rural America isn’t fancy. Milking cows is probably the least fancy thing you could ever choose to do (unless you’re trying to clean out a chicken coop or pigsty). But you learn a thing or two about values growing up on a farm, because no matter how good or bad or just plain messy your day is, you still need to get up and milk the cows. Life on a farm takes dedication, resiliency, and being okay with getting your hands dirty.

You can’t talk about problems on farms because they’ll keep getting worse while you’re sitting around talking about them. You have to actually go out and fix them. Talking doesn’t solve anything on a farm – action does. It should be the same way in Washington. I’m not going to waste time talking about problems as a way of solving them. I’m going to pass legislation and get things done. Hard work is what fixes things, and I’m ready to work hard for you in Washington.

Rural America to me is about hard work, dedication, and resiliency. That’s what patriotism is to me, too. Rural Wisconsin is my home and I will fight for it in Washington.

I’m asking you today: will you join our team and fight on behalf of rural Americans? We all deserve to be represented in our federal government – that’s what democracy is all about. I’m ready to bring the voice of Rural America to the table.

You can donate any amount here: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brad-pfaff-for-rural-america](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45233946/345047405/-774467154?refcode=ABD_EM_FR_2022.05.12_b1_rural2-brad_X_F1_S1_C1__ac&amount=5&utm_campaign=abd_em_fr_2022.05.12_b1_rural2-brad_x_f1_s1_c1__ac&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMmNlNDc1ZS0xZGQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZjomtJgcxk5TiimJcob14YYs2JxFhW3Fk0SYwqZfxlA=)**

Thank you,

Brad Pfaff

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zko7hakgct609k4bjp8pqmt079jr1a0pl0vgddlg_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpjm1ob4cph2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmorc7ep2u5i9f766jhast7m2cl0vpmgn1v1c518_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpjm1ob4cph2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe
VP, Development

Hi friend,

It's candidate forum season!

With the June 7th Primary deadline next month, it's that time of a campaign when most of our neighbors realize that there is an election around the corner and they should start doing a little research. It's also the time when civic organizations, such as the League of Women voters, step up to provide that information.

Most of the focus of the June Primary Season has been on local races. For example, Butte has a contentious race for County Supervisor in which Debra Lucero is fighting to keep her seat in the face of a gerrymander by the Republican Board of Supervisors. Other counties have a similar focus right now: Shasta and Tehama have candidate Q&A's, but the organizers preferred to keep them county-focused when I asked if I could participate. That's understandable, but I'm looking forward to more events that will welcome me as a speaker in the General Election.

The one exception was Yuba County. I attended a candidate's night in Maryville this week and had a blast. Most of the candidates were running for county positions, but David Zink and I made the trip down from Butte to pitch ourselves for Congress and State Assembly respectively. subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z323ltnv1fdequ9om7aj22atibedebh0o9v73vcg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbpm9dbje8qbcsj7mkoe6cr66epm2phic4ob4cthmgobaphheeo6adph6tjmddpnmv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i69j30sllmhjr4cb66jgb4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933clh6cpr0s5i64oh5u)
This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztrm4gabr4g067fmpmg2p3jhlj33uoaou0fjvo60_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpjm1ob4c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjp54bbigidaevccro6iksje47sm1t7rce32fo60_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpjm1ob4c9h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;

name: Ron Johnson
subject: I am humbly asking...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Patriot,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask, Patriot, for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---

Ron Johnson

Wade_ , as the leaked Supreme Court draft decision suggests is coming, would represent a terrible attack on our constitutional freedoms and the trampling of legal precedent, long-standing norms, and the will of the vast majority of Americans. My colleagues in the House and I will encourage Senate Democrats to keep making the case with the few Republicans who support _Roe v. clean_body: | | | Yesterday, the Senate voted against the Women's Health Protection Act. The WHPA would protect abortion rights nationwide, no matter what the Supreme Court does. Enshrined in the Roe v. Wade decision is not just the right to an abortion, but elemental concepts of privacy and bodily autonomy. An overturn of Roe v. Wade , as the leaked Supreme Court draft decision suggests is coming, would represent a terrible attack on our constitutional freedoms and the trampling of legal precedent, long-standing norms, and the will of the vast majority of Americans. In the House, we passed the Women's Health Protection Act months ago. The Senate had a chance to protect those freedoms yesterday, but not a single Republican stood up for liberty and freedom. Senators Murray and Cantwell were on our side but even their passionate support could not overcome the Republicans' filibuster. My colleagues in the House and I will encourage Senate Democrats to keep making the case with the few Republicans who support Roe v. Wade that a temporary suspension of the filibuster to protect reproductive freedom is practical, precedented, and necessary. But there is something looming that is even worse than minority Republicans in the Senate obstructing the passage of national abortion rights: majority Republicans passing a nationwide abortion ban. This is exactly what Mitch McConnell has promised is on the table if Republicans take over Congress this November. Here is what we know: Time and again, we have seen Mitch McConnell upend long-standing norms in pursuit of narrow interests over those of the American people. That is why this election is an all-hands-on-deck campaign. We have to expand our majorities in the House and Senate and protect abortion rights. ## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel becoming energy independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
|
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons, or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professionals, friends and neighbors.

body:
Most of the money we raise to re-elect Mark comes from the people donating what they can, when they can.
#

Friends —
We send a number of fundraising emails, so today we thought it was important to **show** you why.
See the chart below? That's how this campaign is funded. For every one large donation we receive, there are thousands of small ones. And when it’s all said and done, most of the money we raise to re-elect Mark comes from people like you donating what they can, when they can.

**Sen. Rick Santorum endorses Barletta for Governor**
---
Former Pennsylvania U.S. Senator Rick Santorum today endorsed Lou Barletta, former mayor and congressman, to be the next governor of Pennsylvania. Santorum served in the U.S. Senate from 1995 to 2007 and ran for the Republican nomination for president in 2012. Barletta has been at or near the top of every public poll released in the race so far. The Republican primary is Tuesday, May 17, 2022.

Santorum issued the following statement:

“I have known Lou Barletta for over 20 years and he has always been a solid conservative who has never shied away from the battles that need to be fought. Hi Peter, Yesterday, I released my budget proposal for the 2022-2023 fiscal year, and it’s a strong plan that builds on our success in North Carolina. In our budget, we prioritize investment in workforce training so folks can access high-paying jobs, expanding access to quality health care, investment in infrastructure development, and keeping our air and drinking water clean. **This budget also gives our state another opportunity to raise public school teacher pay and finally expand Medicaid coverage.** Here are a few highlights from our budget:
* **Commits to A Healthier North Carolina** by proposing a Medicaid expansion to provide access to affordable health care coverage to more than 600,000 North Carolinians who need it
* **Empowers Safe, Successful Communities** by supporting first-time homebuyers and expanding affordable housing options
* **Ensures a Healthy, Resilient NC** by advancing clean energy and energy efficiency
* **Provides a Sound Basic Education for All Students** by investing in educator pay, Pre-K programs, and high-quality childcare
* **Creates Stronger Workforce for Better Paying Jobs** by expanding work-based learning grants, increasing job training opportunities, and supporting small businesses

**[If you’d like to learn more about our budget proposal, you can read the full budget recommendation here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45237116/345060867/-62238120?refcode=ea.0d283ffd-25d2-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ms=ea.0d283ffd-25d2-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDI4M2ZmZC0yNWQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KU2_1zkpWvfcAV4njTD0ncfbHQHzT_3rNLU6AYjNpZo=&emci=f9273ffd-25d2-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=0d283ffd-25d2-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=1049176)** Peter, we have already done a great deal to help North Carolina families recover from the worst days of the pandemic, but there’s still more work to do. Birthdays on the campaign trail look much different than those off the trail. However, Kelvin understands the importance of this election to defeat Ralphael Warnock and take back the Senate, so he's on the road hitting three events today in the place of celebrating.

[I'm asking everyone to please show your support for Kelvin by making a special birthday donation and leaving a little message of encouragement along with your donation.](https://gop.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435843e25393f24c78349b03f&id=300fdf11cb&e=7bbb93570f) Every dollar raised is going towards voter contact as we close out this primary and prepare for a runoff!

We've worked hard to spread Kelvin's message of preserving the American dream, and I can't think of a better birthday gift than helping to continue that. In honor of his birthday, let's help him win for Georgia and #WinforAmerica!

Sincerely,
Janelle King

| | Hey Peter, The primary election is only a few days away, and it’s easier than ever to vote–you just have to make sure that your ballot is postmarked (collected by USPS) on or before Tuesday, May 17th (Election Day), or you can turn your ballot in at a ballot drop box by 8 pm on May 17th. (Find a ballot box near you **[here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45237944/345064867/719410068?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFhZWRiYmY1LTI5ZDItZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4YzMyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=B21W2a70WkETlGVk4mHaiwFO8LwCisdCa7tTHWmymJ4=&emci=c9217c2d-bcd0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=aaedbbf5-29d2-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2107230)**!) There’s a lot at stake this election, including deciding which candidates for governor are going to be on the ballot this November. You can find OLCV endorsements online [**here**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45237945/345064868/-1086607047?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFhZWRiYmY1LTI5ZDItZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4YzMyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=B21W2a70WkETlGVk4mHaiwFO8LwCisdCa7tTHWmymJ4=&emci=c9217c2d-bcd0-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=aaedbbf5-29d2-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2107230)! I like to vote early, so I already mailed in my ballot. For governor, the choice was easy–I voted for former Oregon House Speaker Tina Kotek. Tina has a proven track record when it comes to climate. She’s been behind every one of Oregon’s greatest climate victories in the last ten years, and that’s just the beginning. I care about the climate, and about creating a better future for the next generation, and I know Tina does too. That’s why she’s endorsed by OLCV! She’s the climate champion in the race for governor, and I hope you’ll join me in filling in the box next to her name. Another climate champion–who I wish I could vote for, but I don’t live in her district–is Andrea Salinas for Congress. From her time as an OLCV board member to her work as a state representative, Andrea has shown up with a strong work ethic to fight for our climate and our future. Please vote for Andrea if you’re in her district! She’s up against Carrick Flynn, who–if you haven’t heard–is against protections for spotted owls and sympathetic to Timber Unity. In many cases, the primary election is going to determine what our choices look like this fall. Voting is easier than ever before, and there are some great candidates waiting for your vote. Be sure to check out all of OLCV’s endorsements at **olcv.org/2022-primary-endorsements** for a full list of climate and environmental champions. Happy voting!

Francesca Varela
Communications Coordinator, OLCV |

The Second Amendment is a cornerstone of our great nation. So when the government tried to close gun stores during the lockdowns, I sued to keep them open. And I won! Friend,

It was a direct attack on your Second Amendment right, Friend. But protecting your Constitutional rights is one of the most important jobs of being a Congresswoman.

That’s why I’m running for Congress. I am a mother of six, and I want my children to grow up in a free country with the protections of our Constitution.

Peter,

Since it was reported last week that a draft opinion shows the Supreme Court is poised to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , Republicans are continuing their attacks on reproductive rights.

**Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell just said a ban that would make abortion illegal nationwide is "possible."** That means regardless of whether you live in a blue state like Rhode Island or a red state, Republicans are trying to take away access to abortion services.

If Republicans take control of Congress, the first thing they will do is pass a national ban on abortion that will override state level protections. More than ever, we need leaders like Seth in Congress who will defend reproductive rights and work to ensure _Roe_ is codified into law.

As Treasurer, Seth worked to pass legislation to codify _Roe_ into Rhode Island law. Now, he's ready to continue standing up for reproductive rights in Congress. But he's up against Allan Fung, a Trump-supporting Republican, who just last week repeated his opposition to making _Roe v. Wade_ the law in Rhode Island and accepted the endorsement of a group that wants to criminalize abortion.

**Congressman Fred Keller endorses Barletta for Governor**
---
Former mayor and congressman Lou Barletta, leading Republican candidate for governor of Pennsylvania, today announced the formal endorsement of Congressman Fred Keller (PA-12). Keller's endorsement comes on the heels on a windfall of other key endorsements coalescing behind Barletta's surging campaign.
"I've known Lou for many years and he's exactly who Pennsylvania needs as our next Governor," said **Congressman Fred Keller**. "Lou started his own successful business, served in an executive role as Mayor of Hazleton where he fought illegal immigration, and led the America First movement as a Congressman. His experience is unmatched. Importantly, he is the only Republican candidate who can win both the primary and general elections. Lou has my full support and endorsement."

clean_body: We can’t repeat 2018’s primary turnout = | Fellow activist, Only 18% of the Commonwealth’s registered voters turned out to vote in Pennsylvania’s last midterm primary election — despite us having both gubernatorial and US Senate races on the ballot. That's abysmal compared to the national average of 26.5% turnout for gubernatorial primaries that same year. We have a repeat of 2018’s combined midterm, gubernatorial, and Senate races, but we can’t afford to repeat the low turnout. = = If recent events have taught us anything, it’s the importance of primary voting. The choices we make in this primary could mean the difference between officials that act to safeguard our rights and ones that put out statements of thoughts and prayers after we lose them. That’s why it’s so important for every Black, brown, and young voter across the Commonwealth to get out and vote their values in the May 17th primary election in Pennsylvania. = In solidarity, Team NPP = | The New Pennsylvania Project was founded in May 2021 to expand Pennsylvania’s electorate, so it reflects the Commonwealth’s demographically changing population. In the next four years, NPP will engage and empower young residents and those living in underrepresented communities of color and immigrant communities. We will register them to vote, provide education about the issues that matter in their neighborhoods, and mobilize people to vote in every election. = PA ELECTION DATES : PRIMARY: May 17, 2022 GENERAL: November 8, 2022 || || || New Pennsylvania Project 717 Market Street #295 Lemoyne, PA 17043 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. to receive fewer emails from us. to stop receiving any fundraising emails from us. Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zctghs6bsps7neua558hmki040hdfn8j1f2eqsj0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpge1pj4cth2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. name: Laurie Teper
subject: FINAL PUSH!
body:
Hi Friends of Courtney Geels,

WE NEED THREE THINGS TO DO FROM NOW UNTIL TUESDAY.

1. Knock on doors at homes that voted a Republican ballot in the last
primary *this Saturday, May 14 in Orange County. While doing this, I've
met a lot of great people who are like minded! *Meet at the Teper
home, *2833
Percussion Dr in Hillsborough* at *9:00*. Snacks, water, and coffee
provided and bathrooms available. Park on the pull through driveway. We are
combining our efforts to help get Geels for US Congress and Bethni for
Orange County School Board across the finish line. Feel free to do it on
your own time as well!
2. *Make phone calls! *Have a phone banking party, do it on your own
time OR, if the weather is bad on Saturday, we will make calls from my
house. Scripts are provided and we have the potential to reach thousands of
residents. If they don't answer the call, we leave a message that they will
hear!
3. *Pass out palm cards at the polls!* People have noticed the
opposition is at most of the precincts. We need you there representing
Courtney in every county! Give one, two or three+ hours of your time
Friday, Saturday and Tuesday. Email, text or call me and I'll plug you in
the place and time that it is convenient for YOU!

Please sign up here *for door knocking and phone banking on Saturday*:
*https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADA629A3FACE9-canvassing
<https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0E4CADA629A3FACE9-canvassing>*

Follow us on Twitter <https://twitter.com/courtneygeels>, Instagram
<https://www.instagram.com/courtneygeels/>, and give us a like on Facebook
<https://www.facebook.com/CourtneyGeelsForCongress> to keep up with
Courtney.
Be sure to like and share!

*Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity together!*

Laurie Teper
Volunteer Coordinator
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com
Cell: (847)212-5651

| | | Friend, **__**For Granite State families and families across the country,_THIS_ has become the biggest concern... I’m talking about the devastating consequences of the **_failed economic policies_** that have come out of Washington! Inflation is at a 40-year high with no end in sight. Our national GDP actually had _negative_ growth in the first quarter of 2022. **And grocery prices rose 8.6% in March alone!** All the while, Joe Biden and Hollywood Hassan have only made excuses. They’ve tried to blame everything from COVID-19 to Ukraine, but the truth is that this broken economy is the direct result of unchecked government spending and complete lack of fiscal discipline at the federal level. We need real solutions like the kind I put forward as State Senate President here in New Hampshire. That’s why, as a candidate for the U.S. Senate running to replace Hassan and her excuses, **I’m excited to put forward the following plan to**** _FIX_****Washington’s mistakes and****MAKE OUR ECONOMY GREAT AGAIN!**

---
---
| |
---
| | [JOIN ME: MAKE OUR ECONOMY GREAT AGAIN!](https://click.mlsend2.com/link/c/YT0xOTQ4NjUzMTY2ODY2MjA5MTczJmM9dTNzNCZlPTAmYj05Njg2MDMzMTkmZD1uM3gwejBy.sOyXfqB764P7XTrGT3nuiYJR1QgfwkfOn5O1fVuk8Go)
---
---
| | | Take a look at some of the provisions below: **#1: Return Fiscal Responsibility to Washington** \- At its most basic, inflation is the result of government debt increasing beyond the ability to repay. With Biden and Hassan spending a fortune on far-left priorities, it’s only adding fuel to the inflation fire. And worse yet - much of the debt becomes held by foreign countries like China. We need fiscal discipline, balanced budgets, and sustainable economic growth: just like we have here in New Hampshire. **#2: Restore Energy Independence** \- When President Trump was in charge, the U.S. was on the path back to energy independence. But the Biden Administration, with the help of Maggie Hassan, has returned us to the days of relying on foreign governments like Russia and Middle East nations. Now, gas prices are $2 more than they were in September 2021 - we need to supercharge our energy production and cut the bureaucratic red tape to end this crisis. **#3: Cut Regulations** \- Unnecessary federal regulations are far too often the cause of artificially high prices for everyday commodities. We should undertake a thorough review of federal regulations to cut the unnecessary waste. **#4: Resolve Supply Chain Issues** \- We’ve all seen videos of cargo ships lined up at sea and barren shelves in grocery stores... It’s time for major reform on the way our supply chain is regulated, including stopping unions and environmentalists from holding back our progress. **#5: Reverse Policies that Make America Less Competitive** \- Greater capacity for domestic manufacturing, in addition to lowering our combined corporate tax rate which is _HIGHER_ than the international standard, will help prevent our country from being at a disadvantage. **There is no quick fix to all of the damage that Hassan and Biden have done to our economy. But it’s crucial that we stop their disastrous policies before it’s too late...** We need balanced spending, not overregulation. We need to do things the 603 Way - not the D.C. Way. **We need to Make Our Economy**** __Great__****Again!**

| | Friend, I have exciting news! House Bill 2106, which will phase out the grocery sales tax in Kansas, has become law. The Legislature deserves the credit for answering our bipartisan calls to reduce or eliminate the state sales tax on groceries. In November, I called on the Legislature to reduce or eliminate the state grocery tax, and Governor Kelly joined in that call a few days later. Over the years, Laura Kelly has made the grocery-tax problem worse. ❌ First, she voted for the biggest sales tax increase in Kansas history in 2010, which amounted to a more than $1 billion tax increase on Kansas families between 2011 to 2013 and more than $150 million each year since. ❌ Then, as governor in 2019 she vetoed two bills that would have reduced or eliminated the food tax. If she would have signed the phase-out bill then, our current 6.5% grocery tax (second-highest in the nation) would already be down to 2.9% and be at 0% by January next year. ❌ This year, she strangely spent time and energy running about the state for hatchet-wielding media stunts in grocery stores that accomplished nothing except to promote Laura Kelly. I preferred to actually work with Republican legislative leaders who, with bipartisan support, got the job done on grocery-tax relief, property-tax relief for homeowners, and other tax relief for farmers and ranchers, teachers and many other Kansans. If you are ready for real leadership that will work with our Legislature to meet the needs of Kansans and not AGAINST it - will you join our campaign today?

clean_body: I have exciting news! House Bill 2106, which will phase out the grocery sales tax in Kansas, has become law. The Legislature deserves the credit for a| | | | | Friend, I have exciting news! House Bill 2106, which will phase out the grocery sales tax in Kansas, has become law. The Legislature deserves the credit for answering our bipartisan calls to reduce or eliminate the state sales tax on groceries. In November, I called on the Legislature to reduce or eliminate the state grocery tax, and Governor Kelly joined in that call a few days later. Over the years, Laura Kelly has made the grocery-tax problem worse. ❌ First, she voted for the biggest sales tax increase in Kansas history in 2010, which amounted to a more than $1 billion tax increase on Kansas families between 2011 to 2013 and more than $150 million each year since. ❌ Then, as governor in 2019 she vetoed two bills that would have reduced or eliminated the food tax. If she would have signed the phase-out bill then, our current 6.5% grocery tax (second-highest in the nation) would already be down to 2.9% and be at 0% by January next year. ❌ This year, she strangely spent time and energy running about the state for hatchet-wielding media stunts in grocery stores that accomplished nothing except to promote Laura Kelly. I preferred to actually work with Republican legislative leaders who, with bipartisan support, got the job done on grocery-tax relief, property-tax relief for homeowners, and other tax relief for farmers and ranchers, teachers and many other Kansans. If you are ready for real leadership that will work with our Legislature to meet the needs of Kansans and not AGAINST it - will you join our campaign today? As governor, I will continue working with the Legislature to provide sustainable, long-term tax relief for Kansans suffering the effects of big-government inflation. I will not veto legislation that will bring relief to Kansas families, especially when they are already hurting under Washington, D.C.’s spending sprees. It’s time we bring change to Kansas, and this was just step one. Thank you, Derek Schmidt | | | | | PAID FOR BY DEREK SCHMIDT FOR KANSAS, INC., KELLY ARNOLD, TREASURER. | | | | | ---|---|---

name: Alvin Williams, President
subject: Did you miss this?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Black America's PAC Action Fund
body:
-
I’m putting this at the TOP of your inbox.
| | Dear Peter, I’m putting this at the TOP of your inbox to make sure you didn’t miss my email to you. Ever since John James announced his candidacy for the House of Representatives, the Democrats have been hell-bent on defeating him. He needs your support more than ever if he’s going to reclaim enough Black voters in Michigan to help put him in Congress. Read my email below to see how you can help.
---
| [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=1)
---
_For America,_ |
---
**Alvin Williams**
President & CEO
BAMPAC, BAMPAC Action Fund
[DONATE](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=2)
---
\- - - - - - Begin Forward - - - - - - **From:** Alvin Williams
**Sent:** Friday, April 22nd 2022 02:00 PM
**To:** Peter
**Subject:Democrats' worst nightmare**
---
| |
---
| | [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=3)
---
| Peter, There's nothing Democrats fear more than outspoken Black conservatives exposing their Liberal LIES about "racist" conservatives to Black voters... ...but a popular Black, Christian conservative, _Army combat veteran, and successful businessman_ like John James **running for Congress** is the **Democrats' worst nightmare**. **[I'm hoping you'll endorse John James for the U.S. House of Representatives, but first let me explain why the Democrats are so terrified of him.](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=4)** The Democrats are gearing up for war, and they fully expect to maintain control of the House this election. **But behind the scenes,_they're terrified_ that John James is about to thwart their entire takeover plot.** And they have good reason to be afraid. | [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=5)
---
##### Captain John James will be the next U.S. Congressman from Michigan, but only with your help.
After all, they saw first-hand in previous elections what John is capable of - _watching in horror as he soared from a 21-point deficit to just 7 points within a few short months._
Shocked that their supposedly _"unbeatable"_ Senator was on the verge of losing to a _"nobody"_ political outsider...
...the panicked Democrats were forced to dump **over $15 million** into slowing down John's relentless surge just enough for well-known, deep-pocketed, and entrenched Democrat Senator Debbie Stabenow to narrowly squeak past.
# John James won more votes (1.9 million) than ANY Republican in Michigan in over a decade.
The Democrats are terrified because they know that if John can nearly topple one of the most powerful Democrats in the U.S. Senate...
**...then they don't stand a chance against John James this election!**
John is a successful, articulate, and intelligent Black conservative whose impeccable character is impossible for liberals to deface with slander and lies.
He's a West Point graduate, Ranger-qualified aviation officer, and retired Army Captain who served with distinction while leading two Apache helicopter platoons in Iraq.
He's also a successful businessman, having quadrupled his company's revenue and added 100 new employees in his first 5 years as President.
And through each step of his journey, John has led with courage, conviction, and a servant-first mentality that comes from his Christian faith.
[](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=6)
---
##### "I am a conservative who happens to be black. I'm in the Republican Party because the platform most aligns with my values. I am pro-life. I am pro-Second Amendment. I am pro-family. I am pro-business."
John calls himself an _"unapologetic Christian, pro-life, pro-business, pro-Second Amendment, conservative outsider"_ but Fox News and others are calling him _**"The future of the GOP."**_
**[And if this isn't enough to make you want to help send John James to the U.S. House of Representatives...](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=7)**
**...let me tell you what scares the Democrats most about John James.**
**John is on a mission to reclaim Black voters by exposing the Liberal LIE that conservatives like you and me are racists.**
He's opening their eyes to the _"Democratic brand of dependency that's being peddled"_ by unmasking Democrats as opportunistic, self-serving politicians who prey on Blacks with lies, empty promises, and failed policies.
And John's damning critiques of the Democrat Party and honest outreach to the Black Community are reclaiming Black voters to the Republican Party.
**John James is a serious threat to the Democrat Party, and they know it!**
_"He's SPECTACULAR. Rarely have I seen a candidate with such great potential. West Point graduate, successful businessman, and an African American leader...**He will be a star.** "_
-President Donald Trump
---
**To say the Democrats are panicking would be an understatement.**
They know John can reclaim enough Black voters to convert Michigan from a long-standing Democrat stronghold into the newest "red state."
And they know that winning a U.S. Congressional race will catapult John to national stardom, guaranteeing that millions of Black voters across America will hear his powerful message and begin fleeing the Democrat Party.
Once elected, Congressman John James will work tirelessly to:
* **EXPOSE** the Liberal Lies to the entire nation
* **RECLAIM** Black voters to the Republican Party
* **END** the Democrats' death-grip on the Black Community

**And Democrats know that if they lose just 12% of the Black vote, it'll be impossible for them to ever win another election.**
# That's why Democrats are terrified of John James and WILL STOP AT NOTHING TO SHUT HIM UP
**[That’s why I pray you'll also make an urgent, recurring donation of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more to help John FIGHT BACK against the Democrats' vicious attacks!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=8)**
BAMPAC Action Fund played an ACTIVE roll helping John James shrink the margin between him and his opponent in the previous election.
With your help, we were able to place billboards in key areas throughout Michigan, like the one you see here:
[](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=9)
---
We also ran radio ads in 3 of the largest black communities in Michigan and reached voters through online video ads in 10 key Michigan counties.
These online video ads were targeted towards Black Americans who’d voted in 2 of the last 4 elections up to that point.
And with your help... _we’ll do it again!_
John James really is _**"the future Republicans have been waiting for,"**_ but that future may never arrive without your committed support.
The Democrats are desperate to STOP John from taking this critical Congressional seat and END his campaign to recruit Black voters to the Republican Party.
And make no mistake about it: the future of our shared conservative values depends on our ability to reclaim Black voters from the Democrats.
**[That’s why your _monthly_ gift of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more is so critical now more than ever!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=10)**
Real change takes time and commitment, and I know that you’re in this fight for the long-haul.
I know you won’t allow our conservative values to fall to the wayside by failing to build a conservative future.
That’s why I’m counting on your help TODAY.
**[So please help defend John James from Democrat attacks and DESTROY the liberal lies with your _monthly_ gift of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more TODAY!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=11)**
Thank you, and God Bless.
| [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=12)
---
_For America,_ |
---
**Alvin Williams**
President & CEO
BAMPAC, BAMPAC Action Fund
[DONATE](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=13)
---
**P.S.** John James is the **Democrats' worst nightmare** because he's reclaiming Black voters to the Republican Party by exposing the Liberal LIES about "racist" conservatives that keep Blacks voting for Democrats... **...and he's the ONLY ONE who can win this crucial House race and thwart their plans to retake the U.S. House of Representatives this election.** **That's why they'll stop at nothing to SHUT HIM UP!** **[That’s why I pray you'll make an urgent, monthly contribution of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more to support John James up through Election Day.](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=14)** **As a conservative leader in your community, your support is critical to beat back the Democrats' vicious attacks and propel John James to victory.[So please give what you can today.](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0405&recruiter_id=62420&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=15)**
---
|

Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation and name of employer of individuals whose contributions exceed $200 in a calendar year.
---

If you're giving up on this critical fight, then please [click here](https://www.bampac.org/unsubscribe?e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0405&n=16) to stop receiving emails.

Friends, It has been a tough few years for the Asian American Pacific Islander (AAPI) community in the United States. In Maryland, hate crimes targeting Asian Americans have more than doubled since 2018. **Our nation 's response to the rise in Asian American hate has been insufficient to say the least. **The AAPI community in Maryland deserves leadership that will adequately address their concerns -- leadership that will make their lives safer. _Candace and I promise to provide that leadership for Maryland. _ We will ensure that the AAPI community and all marginalized communities receive the attention, resources, representation, and services needed to truly thrive. As Montgomery County State's Attorney, I hired the first Asian American prosecutors in Montgomery County history to that office. Through hiring, I also significantly increased the number of Asian Americans at both the State's Attorney's Office and Attorney General's office. I'll do the same as governor. If you want a governor and lieutenant governor who will make Maryland a more safe, just, and strong place to live for everyone --**we ask for your support.** **[Will you sign-on to endorse our campaign so that we have the support needed to win this competitive primary?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnnrbX48rtyZKDgfG4uTIuAkVGK4UdrmFlokRA4DqEE2-oudPk0FN3lFQpui2DuUwm2SlahFtb_W2if_FnfDzQA4t9nPk0Sd7DJ6L3jzoh0-Mm20FbQnjAbLOBOMdkFaLEVG7kAqWVRqyKHzADAzkxpsF64gCp8sh0F9AujUK-0GaBfXDGURUJaU9hJtfr7sBfYRtULXqGZaie6mHNGZHYwyLPvCCimX5hQRp4i6pkE7JmKDT1xaI4sv0JeM-8ZnuFaVOnL6kDEmPS-yx9L1tpBa8HLFcyFZex_6AtOg7BlUYw/3lz/rTyzZjloTTKLwzffe__bUQ/h1/TDF-4ZFSENFf5O12wufwye8tnYhi9vmtyGVZUgUGp8I)**

| Fellow Patriot,
This week, a leak showed the _Supreme Court is ready to overturn Roe v. Wade_...ending one of the greatest injustices in American history.
_No one_ understands the horrors of abortion more than the Black Americans...with **_more than 20 million Black babies killed_** through abortion since 1973.
But BLEXIT recognizes that ending _Roe v. Wade is NOT_ the end of our fight to protect life.
**We need to rebuild a culture of courage, personal responsibility, and respect for life in our communities.**
BLEXIT is doing tough work in our communities every day...and showcasing the _tremendous power_ of traditional American values:
* We believe that Black Americans have **unlimited potential to achieve the American Dream.**

* We know that our **nation’s values empower every one of us** , regardless of race.

* Unlike Black Lives Matter, **we fight to protect ALL Black lives..._including_ our unborn children.**

Black Americans are waking up. **[But BLEXIT’s efforts to rebuild, reshape, and reclaim Black America can only be as successful as your help.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zms7c13mert46grjdpehkt3pk89g9k6glmra5vmg_rp22sh2s8i66pb2cpie8o34cjh2bs)**

Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people. | [](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZ6CoC8mijfMXmZ12ibqkuv_aedXGk45x09WG95jooH3u9TqF-Cs68UYlYTGgA4fkJBc5iMogVFfvFD6eU36l_J4_grRnfd9DbOL42yJIBUXM-FdfEEbRxw0BXidlY-yBbOPwIubCqDtxVSejxhSs7mj-i85V8fyQQ4JmIK8Ogp3Dylxv-5K70xmilLurhljtIK2wR8jiTxGgFWvniuNkDzbbeE1gkSo6m6uo2n5OzdXc%3D)

Fellow American,

I want to tell you something that’s been on my mind.

Becoming a politician was never my dream. In fact, I didn’t think I was cut out for it. Why? Because I didn’t grow up in this world where everyone knows everyone, and people live in fancy houses, and regular people run for office. _It’s just not me._

**I believe in God, country, and family.** I believe in making it home by 6pm so I can have a conversation with my wife and hear about my daughter’s day at school. I believe in praying before we eat dinner. I believe that God is in control of my life, not the government. I believe in actually being proud of the work that I do _and making a difference for the next generation._ [**I think that Washington could use a little more of that.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZVEbd4ECv7ehMbsz-JtJKqRriNs35KYUONSd0ZWukh4-FXcurA-YyY_9Rgmkt3Hznn2F6HrTn46t5QZNnwmVEY3Z-1R-UpfmutUSw8y06_xhsX6AyLpQbVImHbsqztolqBckVuwu-KPzRYUfEhWT7yUBGtINjyDo5Clj4OvkPPDJA6QsO2XYAN_gTUn3q2tOCH_nlwfjrGYbyweqbFCsFV8-IBnvwzkr8A496YjjXFNY%3D)

[**SEND A POLITICAL-OUTSIDER TO CONGRESS » **](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZw1SuEbzHnyomqrbhexFoJ5ryNhY0X_2BcA9LH-bUyn66jXqnlYy07O6zlez7XuTMRByL6LALRSXc3mghenUHgFNEmbagmm3WPJEwkDjE2xPuvpaCwn9_nhaMDFZIaoniNDBux4EwsyU_ZicBM2VFkfEADL_dXX8oly28jpieQNWOafEy0SFa9RnbGoDZ0yI1U4CRiD1vbCYswVJNS5BjZMb_yosWhYMtiIS-Zhshe9g%3D)
**Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people.**

[**Congress _does_ needs someone like me,**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZwMBLaq-nIDW6U_KA3uje7NxW1xv_MZ5ZWMZD7gKGVFk9PDK9wpN4jpWgLSEgxISLj_ev7H8AwT5KRs2cxkPSivUnxztZi8kQ6-01a37wBt-FstBbum4-tWDFKHAKiWjvNrrwU7ie2yssfS7kpsbJimPMkf1Wm212WVfJidq803zlbybdtMN2Ny61N1HXFUZOMwvkiaNw4gOkMBZx2pyc7S9H4ZPgFRSrgnQ_MvNQh2Y%3D) who fills up their own gas at the station, grocery shops with their wife on the weekend, and cracks a beer open with their neighbors to watch football in the fall.

I know the struggles of ordinary life, and I was raised to have a good head on my shoulders. Through Sunday school, I learned important lessons like that you should listen more than you talk, and to be grateful for all of your blessings.

[**Fellow American, it’s people like you and I who SHOULD be representing Americans in Congress – not the elite-circle that currently runs DC.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZGcw09w5JyIXokEP2ye7sBDnR5Lndc-1x0wifIIE5S4lGAMdk7PgwEKm006H8LodyZm44TTpIfjbb6L85BsJGeP9jKtFwcKCt71CVC4sUbHv0RjO4CkXZ4Vh138y4Xpw-92LufVt2-PpddSFhsViMA5C3_ibyKJ2UOu24IPBe6JAM0xrdsoHYNi2xZiRc-u-rBzJKm7wRcIFFjQKwh_a7u9nYRtZoi2Mnt4gH_tE22NY%3D)

Here’s the problem though. The reason that the elite run Washington is because they have the funds to do it – _but I have you._ [**Will you support me with a contribution of $5, maybe $10 bucks today and send a political outsider to Washington?**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZYp8PKmt-SvK0kggdLVGK3L3TDXC1bIIw8qYd_Xms1x5-CZMLCwv5z49d1EbX6qtfCIjutA-BNIER_742O5NOpLD-_Gxo6Z_ncm_SlfgEP0IFvMDrugeUYCtMwfPLpQSZySzwFiyld0NAEYlrXLrbn0VCb2Cka7MM3JXYjB6YOSICWgi2_Fz9V87hZQ1KNICDoGudIg2Hxk_7YPKXNn0zl6tGZulwGJGCgSSGAIw6uvE%3D)

[**SEND A POLITICAL-OUTSIDER TO CONGRESS » **](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZfE8wnwCY3OHNqtAZDqt3LJN3Kzdc2q2Y6HxdvcZfj8tLWMt7t9kUROOrxM-1pKatxW6Jpi_7SPHgnn5FRAX84wrz5hm5PfplMDF9kfN3Iw5ngATsWi8rNPc2C2buJN2-n0KzU2qIzLG7_vZ2LHr39G5NOWUUBeyuZJi_KGlZELJdxEURSs6rs4icctitb7dKoDpOSA5j9E0SsHuMPubr8RyKkGZzF-zXHbklqKAUDYQ%3D)
[**When I decided to run for Congress the first time, I knew things would be tough.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZ09G5N6cPeC6PunH0lUlL-5txQF-3HU8u603vac65iRN6tqvsj3jWrJAtm0i2lEL00QSdHDukaDNsdBgtj3LTsOeLHumQKHaXF5jfFwU_ghDnPtIVR7GNNREgRvSJ9uJ7fv5vMu7WfEPAKqLivl7mVcvVRHO9TcFXyMk1xzfdJ1G3ujTRCjkPqYpURiqr_SCX7fMzgAuPcmTTqenrpRvvTTnn085zdNJGqeyd9bzfWbQ%3D) I didn’t have the resources, knowledge, or background in politics. Heck! I didn’t even have a campaign manager. But as it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me – we didn’t need another self-serving politician in Washington – we needed a public servant! My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign, losing to a well-funded Democrat by just 2%.

I’m running to unseat the same Democrat once again – and like last time, she’s very well-funded. In fact, [**her latest report to the Federal Elections Commission indicated she has more than $3 million to use in attacks against my campaign.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZ_gDFTO_kg_28J_0D0xu2iUKBDamA4UhgCKA_iYAq9sHLiot3vJa5WD6mj9TMjAgpDA3ZM_MgL_aBbHAo8WI5ImXi6aDCreESBuO8l2WyDfUvgAXHUsecCppIL8TrsvZI8T5Uw0rzgcdBq_RrKgsIKg74-m0_77A40xtFAhoZmzJjiNOYv9ZU8VFtsTy8jz_5qygBDo9gGIyPMlu13T26ZiMQdeDoBeNAzTJikyWO7Zk%3D)

[**In a district with as many Republican voters as Democrats, this race could go either way. That’s why I’m asking for your help today. Will you join my team via contribution of any amount today?**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZg47x35dUSs4X0UZH4mVd9lkSmFYC5EI0uR6kX3pFwGVdPRc7QMLrvTm1U7zeTtykPUUsyY6Wa4CrOCMadnQzaWo1D3pNdGegHBTliP6PhhotXbhtpdSxc2uv1_guHmeGfinvM691RdkSdvgD9HC0r_VRa9IKvaeKAbAtbqY17NNLd_ymwzIbrcX6MiyWcpgRixXczW42OOtFjvVoLPGz_AY04wmSrSjOPGFYIfhp70E%3D)

[**FLIP A TOSSUP HOUSE SEAT » **](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=5df445fadad646079e68fcb05f4fb2f1&_e=g0v_swwVqa1Wed4PlCmpQr4RAQX8ZSY8JjHNF1dKJwEMgfs94CQEFP9rGtGRVKw3saymVW-9B7jFBh8yvKruQwrrFm4X1SeqyNJA-IM1lvaVH18rj4VohHY-iINxIRMp-2oGWXisitaCvpN_bwhXkfZ_Ogsy63dnEtXGqeO03i3LINddJd-U_2CSDGWMZzdCKsvN2N8UrFLrEYF3eLX0qYMj0nHWY8PkQJDXUzTsdM5JvNLKx0KUzsVUFCv_hGgZVEbd4ECv7ehMbsz-JtJKqUyTFitzcRvbq9ubAFPOl4w26escKtqO3XFNE6UJ-0UNyjTaSOtUpUuw_jI_2zI3aU-JMApXiS1PE517t_JYtxwtT2cPzq3V_Rzdad8NAyxgVHGVpdphHbrySGZnDPpa-oDBFU0iLbHdp8ID3-n2UzXaauPioY1BEtj6F7muGm9FOHKRU5_13Cuc9TMtbPpBqkijAguU-LVINh-2Se-kY9k%3D)

clean_body: Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people. | Fellow American, I want to tell you something that’s been on my mind. Becoming a politician was never my dream. In fact, I didn’t think I was cut out for it. Why? Because I didn’t grow up in this world where everyone knows everyone, and people live in fancy houses, and regular people run for office. It’s just not me. I believe in God, country, and family. I believe in making it home by 6pm so I can have a conversation with my wife and hear about my daughter’s day at school. I believe in praying before we eat dinner. I believe that God is in control of my life, not the government. I believe in actually being proud of the work that I do and making a difference for the next generation. Congress doesn’t need another Ivy League educated, fast-talking, slick politician whose been served out of a silver spoon their whole life and is beyond out of touch with what matters to real people. who fills up their own gas at the station, grocery shops with their wife on the weekend, and cracks a beer open with their neighbors to watch football in the fall. I know the struggles of ordinary life, and I was raised to have a good head on my shoulders. Through Sunday school, I learned important lessons like that you should listen more than you talk, and to be grateful for all of your blessings. Here’s the problem though. The reason that the elite run Washington is because they have the funds to do it – but I have you. I didn’t have the resources, knowledge, or background in politics. Heck! I didn’t even have a campaign manager. But as it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me – we didn’t need another self-serving politician in Washington – we needed a public servant! My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign, losing to a well-funded Democrat by just 2%. I’m running to unseat the same Democrat once again – and like last time, she’s very well-funded. body:
I need to tell Holly we’re on track | |
---
Peter, When people hear about political campaigns and political donations, they often assume that these campaigns are financed by people writing massive checks to candidates. In our case, this is simply not the truth. ** ** Since launching our campaign in February of 2021, we have received contributions from over 62,000 folks around the country. The average contribution amount? $29.08. ** ** We've received contributions from hardworking, loyal Democrats from all 50 states.
