disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jeremy for Georgia
body:
I’m a native Georgian and a loyal patriot. I’m also a proud, principled, and outspoken Black conservative. | | | Peter,
My name is Jeremy Hunt.
I’m a former U.S. Army Intelligence Officer, a father, husband, and graduate of West Point.
I’m a native Georgian and a loyal patriot.
**I’m also a proud, principled, and outspoken Black conservative.**
Peter, **I was deployed and spent 2016 in Ukraine training their armed forces on how to respond to external threats to their sovereign territory.**
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7585dc3137f946e39f695dc1b46b1e2e&_e=yj5oITGBAWv3CDTMIuvkNjNBOJ4wxYAqzB0ZYWtKEeut63CyBatx9WTQB_TQ__bdD6PYpTulInT7_uUhJd0uYW35Xwy5lU-uNLvbO1za-foybx6i__4y-0niOtfNvyyNyyTELay7dLBkdE7C_lelQ7P7r19-WHAEL4cF-kQdYxXk-LJMHBqh9yiWoCR-BsOotdztzQWb7H4He05ggTGK5KmrHIB74UJadUFFocBMmCi30-txao8VXdWSjpD-wM6jgDRqMrzyfvViDNdQJktoL23eCKhNC3vH94qX_GajRZn2tkFlpczwT7AI5xctgJuURJEF7HxK6Qd9ujsrAj5eh3CxZ1nwIDcfPe2P_lPnBluDh7kxOsH0t4HkxhUb4kmKMk1b4O4tihm495063FpDmDgdbNIWP_YGyS9WuMlQqv48kyytYhzMnR0_GYPjla2j)
---
Now, I’m running for Congress in Georgia’s 2nd congressional district to be a voice in Congress advocating for a strong and robust military. Right now, the number of veterans serving in the House is dwindling by the year, and quite honestly, that’s dangerous.
Oh – and the district in which I’m running? **Yea,****it hasn’t been held by a Republican since 1875**. But now the tides have finally turned and I know I’m the man to get the job done.
If you’re interested, please continue reading for just a few more moments. If you don’t have the time right now to continue reading, **then I hope you don’t find it too presumptive of me to ask for a small donation to my congressional campaign today**. We need real leaders in Congress – people who actually know how to do the job from day one, not people who yell at news cameras for attention. I care deeply about our country and I want to make this nation better for my family and yours.
[**I can flip this district Republican for the first time since 1875, but only if I have the resources. If you can, please chip in $5, $10, or even $15 right now. I don’t want this opportunity to go to waste.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7585dc3137f946e39f695dc1b46b1e2e&_e=yj5oITGBAWv3CDTMIuvkNjNBOJ4wxYAqzB0ZYWtKEeut63CyBatx9WTQB_TQ__bdD6PYpTulInT7_uUhJd0uYW35Xwy5lU-uNLvbO1za-foybx6i__4y-0niOtfNvyyNyyTELay7dLBkdE7C_lelQ7P7r19-WHAEL4cF-kQdYxXk-LJMHBqh9yiWoCR-BsOotdztzQWb7H4He05ggTGK5KmrHIB74UJadUFFocBMmCjxXBcDdeb1yiMH0jqV9NV0ufLPnRFCPVUVaODqXAzq4hW2V6lNArYdpsD3cqNW9zGLBwHBTSIbNFV0SFIT3fP8H4IVPQwsIdAF1E5ci6lKZwjnW8VTJFZfh9uAXj3KLXP42x4BGngMx3Co1YZB5cfowmPgxO1iTkzqqDyhhoXGcodI7wr9iMNRKoK9W9qWh4Ddd-nt1yGP5lJaBEDVT55o)
---
| | [**CHIP IN TO HELP ME MAKE HISTORY**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7585dc3137f946e39f695dc1b46b1e2e&_e=yj5oITGBAWv3CDTMIuvkNjNBOJ4wxYAqzB0ZYWtKEeut63CyBatx9WTQB_TQ__bdD6PYpTulInT7_uUhJd0uYW35Xwy5lU-uNLvbO1za-foybx6i__4y-0niOtfNvyyNyyTELay7dLBkdE7C_lelQ7P7r19-WHAEL4cF-kQdYxXk-LJMHBqh9yiWoCR-BsOotdztzQWb7H4He05ggTGK5KmrHIB74UJadUFFocBMmCgmKn0wKvbwoT3dGvJatOtsgwPnnjUkj3PA1fQ1GKVQAR1oKPK3vY0SxV8fpbZwkqPUgVCBn_aJO5ZlURF4Y6HJTJoP-7kluJ0tbS8YdeFXNoIB0Fyz-6QUlY3t6zHjeT4mqsDpRtxN50O2ZaB4g8im29lFFJg03FdWnOybpIyFlXA2OGumZtyd__tycZ80UD0nOXj03MwWOg0MVa3uvOX4)
---
We need serious leadership back in Washington, D.C. We don’t need leaders who take weeks and months to make decisions as important as whether to support democracies like Ukraine.
For all of his bluster, Joe Biden is solely responsible for having to shut down not one but TWO American embassies in less than a year. This leadership isn’t leadership at all – it’s an embarrassment**.****While Joe and Hunter Biden were making money off Ukrainian gas companies, I was training Ukrainian military members how to defend themselves from evil dictators like Vladimir Putin.**
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7585dc3137f946e39f695dc1b46b1e2e&_e=yj5oITGBAWv3CDTMIuvkNjNBOJ4wxYAqzB0ZYWtKEeut63CyBatx9WTQB_TQ__bdD6PYpTulInT7_uUhJd0uYW35Xwy5lU-uNLvbO1za-foybx6i__4y-0niOtfNvyyNyyTELay7dLBkdE7C_lelQ7P7r19-WHAEL4cF-kQdYxXk-LJMHBqh9yiWoCR-BsOotdztzQWb7H4He05ggTGK5KmrHIB74UJadUFFocBMmCimXkLo6S3QACIJNjCrMG_fi7dqaxrTcf2f1hdwRQQoSw6D2Mz4sSvUsw7WZRakxXHucMc-ExA-AahRWJ2OBHktn6wTgQh2t1KznkJVhKZwv-FcPN-OxkpDKxE5214bRHp4xDRldf-iGMSQ2DpMZsB58ENqtubtCGbTQa0u7xMSaN30ovHbIu4T2LOWx1b74FgixYGrj0xGosCBuqqVyupA)
---
Like Joe Biden, my Democrat opponent has been in Washington for far too long; he’s lost touch with our district. ** ** As an Army veteran who spent time on the ground in Ukraine, I can tell you, the warning signs that an invasion was imminent were there for years.******Joe Biden was slow to react and we’re now in a major debacle.** ** ** I’m just one man who has a desire to serve his nation and share the knowledge that I’ve acquired through my time helping to strengthen our nation and friendly democracies abroad. [**If you’ve got $5 or $10 to spare and you agree that it’s time to send serious people to Washington, then please join my team today.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7585dc3137f946e39f695dc1b46b1e2e&_e=yj5oITGBAWv3CDTMIuvkNjNBOJ4wxYAqzB0ZYWtKEeut63CyBatx9WTQB_TQ__bdD6PYpTulInT7_uUhJd0uYW35Xwy5lU-uNLvbO1za-foybx6i__4y-0niOtfNvyyNyyTELay7dLBkdE7C_lelQ7P7r19-WHAEL4cF-kQdYxXk-LJMHBqh9yiWoCR-BsOotdztzQWb7H4He05ggTGK5KmrHIB74UJadUFFocBMmCiTWeF-oQDpkLOgt5cfNt7Xj8jSBHp5fbN5_nbNh4PgaYskz9qxHAzNf59OOQHiSbfcCMFtLwvHc2fDYAyIHJPwTEHgERWBAQxKwB-4orLkO9hKlKhqbjGfMxq2EZVzvM7HWZ20m-aRMQG90Kaof4C9W4ZKL0oGMFPAlbsScGh7jb8qptx_DW5b9d0-Kle-cPthv-3lhsE3AhPH_WXUwKip)
As someone who spent a lot of time working and living in Ukraine, I want to get to the bottom of why we haven’t done more to stop Putin’s aggression sooner. When you have someone who knows what they’re looking for, we can get answers. I’m running to get answers.
[**Will you answer my call for help right now?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7585dc3137f946e39f695dc1b46b1e2e&_e=yj5oITGBAWv3CDTMIuvkNjNBOJ4wxYAqzB0ZYWtKEeut63CyBatx9WTQB_TQ__bdD6PYpTulInT7_uUhJd0uYW35Xwy5lU-uNLvbO1za-foybx6i__4y-0niOtfNvyyNyyTELay7dLBkdE7C_lelQ7P7r19-WHAEL4cF-kQdYxXk-LJMHBqh9yiWoCR-BsOotdztzQWb7H4He05ggTGK5KmrHIB74UJadUFFocBMmCic66X7s86JApUgzMqXWSqtNayKxv9eTGQWN4GllGHVkEfudknOdCPumqtCf8-rzdIYGELrmrl96euEq1PkrrH3qH91GJWkm5eX3XmhNaWfNLU1WkJbeD0aEbAOB2kDJAZC5xcK-gcj9r7y6Z6iV3wD_zkgvRkRP2rJKH8Je7fbW2biVfMByf_2FRy-X19pFNJ0iUMg_l65u3kr3ISexKFg)

Judicial Watch continues to exert a powerful impact against public corruption and unlawful government secrecy.
**_Not a week goes by when our investigators and attorneys aren’t unearthing documents corrupt politicians don’t want us...or the American people...to see_.**
**_And hardly a day goes by when we are not in court leading the all-important battles to protect the rule of law!_**

You may know from seeing me and my colleagues on television and radio and from getting my emails that right now Judicial Watch is breaking important ground on critical fronts:

* Our lawsuits compelling states to follow federal law requiring they clean their voter rolls (and help prevent voter fraud) are notching important victories for clean elections. We now have active lawsuits in **Colorado, Illinois** and **..** and more are coming.

* Our **Biden Accountability Project** team continues to uncover incriminating information through Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) _lawsuits_ against U.S. government agencies for records related to serious allegations _and evidence of**Hunter/Joe Biden** corruption and influence-peddling in Ukraine, China and elsewhere_. Our most recent lawsuit against the U.S. State Department about **Hunter Biden** seeks to reveal more secrets about Biden family corruption.

* Our lawsuits are exposing the spread of **Critical Race Theory (CRT)** in our public schools and other public institutions**...** even at the U.S. Military Academy at West Point!

* And a September trial date has been set for the first of our civil rights lawsuits fighting for the First Amendment rights of teachers fired from their jobs just because they dared to criticize CRT and other extremist programs in their school systems.

For 50 years, _Roe v. Wade_ has protected a woman’s constitutional right to an abortion. But _POLITICO_ has reported that the Supreme Court is planning to overturn _Roe_.
Today, I think about my grandmother, who grew up before women had the right to vote. I think about my mother, who served on the board of her local Planned Parenthood and watched from the frontlines as _Roe v. Wade_ became law.
I think about the generations of women who came before me to secure these fundamental rights, and the generations that will come after. And while this news is devastating, I know one thing is for sure: We cannot go backward.
**The time to act is now. We must protect the right to an abortion.**
Now more than ever, we need to protect and expand our Senate majority, and elect pro-choice Democrats everywhere we can.

subject: The question every Republican has to ask themselves

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=251%2E5257348%2EM_Cwu_ ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek,

There is a very important question that every member aspiring to
Republican Party leadership in Washington has to ask themselves.

Am I willing to lie to advance?

Am I willing to support a party leader in Donald Trump, who I know to be
dishonest, unethical and unpatriotic?

Am I willing to undermine the institutions of our democracy?

If the answer to these questions is “yes,” there is a place for you in GOP
leadership. Just look at Kevin McCarthy. He was caught lying about his
reaction to the January 6th attack on the Capitol and Trump’s role in
inciting the mob.

But this wasn’t the scandal. Anyone who has worked with or observed
McCarthy could not have been surprised by a mere falsehood.

The scandal is that his lies are a necessary prerequisite to being a part
of GOP leadership. Tell the truth and you’re out. Peddle the Big Lie and
you’re in. It’s as simple and as terrible as that.

Trump’s GOP is in the grips of the most anti-truth, anti-democratic cult
of personality our country has ever seen.

As the midterms approach, Republicans will only become more power hungry,
and more corrupt. All in an attempt to destroy Joe Biden and hurt
Democrats. That’s a danger to our democracy, and it’s why I ask:

* The Supreme Court stands to overturn Roe v. Wade.
* Congress has failed to pass legislation to protect our voting rights.
* Partisan gridlock seems to be at an all-time high.

Jane has spent 20 years advocating for North Texas families. What I find most impressive about Jane was she was the Chief of Staff for Congressman Marc Veasey when Democrats were in the minority, and was STILL able to pass legislation and secure millions in federal funding for our communities.

For 50 years, _Roe v. Wade_ has protected a woman’s constitutional right to an abortion. But last week, _POLITICO_ reported that the Supreme Court is planning to overturn Roe.

North Dakota Attorney General Drew Wrigley here.

Since Day One, Biden has done nothing but cave to the demands of radical left-wing groups and elite special interests - shutting down the Keystone Pipeline, pushing extreme Green New Deal policies and _going to war with American energy_.

**Republican Attorneys General have been fighting back** \- leading the charge to make America energy independent again and provide relief for Biden-flation.

This November, it will be more important than ever to elect strong conservatives fighting for American energy - [**can you pitch in to support Republican Attorneys General today?**](https://republicanags.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0af7b31298ac68022275a138&id=8b2ed21d41&e=edf8a4d16d)

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: How Gen-X runs for Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220512&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220512&amount=28]
Friend,
Fun news stories are always comparing the bookend generations of “Gen Z” and the “Baby Boomers.” But what if you’re in that middle one that nobody ever really talks about?
I’m 45, so I believe that puts me squarely in the Gen X generation.
I'm young enough that I know how to use an iPad, however I do still prefer to print and handwrite my notes. I’m regularly called on by my dad and step-mom to help navigate their emails (no, even getting elected to Congress won’t make those calls stop), but I still needed a quick primer from some of the younger members of my staff on how to take a decent picture for social media. I sing along to Bob Seger in the car and I’m mildly entertained by a good TikTok video, but you’re unlikely to catch me doing a dance on that platform.
It’s a strange middle ground to find yourself in, but that middle ground kind of makes sense for my district: whether it’s going from a coffee hour at a senior center to speaking to students at MSU, winning as a Democrat in a district that has voted for the last 3 Republican presidential candidates, or putting my die-hard love of MSU aside whenever U of M makes it to a championship (by far the most difficult), I’m most successful when I can live in that middle ground. And in my view, being one of those middle generations helps.

clean_body: Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220512&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220512&amount=28] Friend, Fun news stories are always comparing the bookend generations of “Gen Z” and the “Baby Boomers.” But what if you’re in that middle one that nobody ever really talks about? I’m 45, so I believe that puts me squarely in the Gen X generation. I'm young enough that I know how to use an iPad, however I do still prefer to print and handwrite my notes. I’m regularly called on by my dad and step-mom to help navigate their emails (no, even getting elected to Congress won’t make those calls stop), but I still needed a quick primer from some of the younger members of my staff on how to take a decent picture for social media. I sing along to Bob Seger in the car and I’m mildly entertained by a good TikTok video, but you’re unlikely to catch me doing a dance on that platform. It’s a strange middle ground to find yourself in, but that middle ground kind of makes sense for my district: whether it’s going from a coffee hour at a senior center to speaking to students at MSU, winning as a Democrat in a district that has voted for the last 3 Republican presidential candidates, or putting my die-hard love of MSU aside whenever U of M makes it to a championship (by far the most difficult), I’m most successful when I can live in that middle ground. And in my view, being one of those middle generations helps. Consider chipping in today to help me continue bringing folks together in the middle, whether it's across generations or across party lines. body:
I have an idea. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/18d8e6a50180/help-courtney-geels-support-the-boys-and-girls-club?e=20ac8f046f)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Peter, I want to ask for your help in showing support for a very special ministry in Durham county. I have been volunteering since the beginning of this year once a week with the **Boys and Girls Club** , and the impact I see them making on kids that come from low-income households is immeasurable. I didn't know much about the club before this year. Their "goal is to combat the growing juvenile delinquency problem in the community and ensure that all Club members are on track to graduate from high school with a plan for the future." What I learned quickly is that every child only has to pay $10/year to be a member. The staff at the Club pour their hearts and time into these kids, and most of them come from really broken backgrounds. A lot of the children are from foster or single-parent households. They have been very successful in keeping teenagers engaged and desiring to be there. The club primarily operates using funds raised by donation. **I have spent time talking with the staff there and building relationships, and I would like to help our community as a congressional candidate!**

**Will you partner with me in showing this specific community, filled with children who are in a loving nurturing environment, that WE, as Republicans, want to see them thrive?** I constantly say that I want to see the life, liberty, and pursuit of happiness to be experienced by all my constituents. I believe that starts with the next generation. I can attest that this club gives these kids the support they need to thrive. They keep up with their grades in school. They assist some of the children during the day by doing remote learning as needed. They talk to the older children about staying off of drugs and prioritizing their futures. It would be so great to be able to SHOW them that Republicans want to see these kids grow and help stop the cycle of poverty in Durham.

The Boys and Girls Club has been very gracious to let me come in with a team from Courtney Geels for Congress to present a gift to them. **Will you please consider making a donation to this wonderful nonprofit?**

Contributions made to the Boys and Girls Club **ARE tax-deductible**, and **ALL of this money will go directly to the Boys and Girls Club of Durham**. Courtney Geels for Congress will purchase pizza for the children on June 7th. **Please join me there at 4pm on June 7th wearing your Courtney Geels for Congress shirt and help me distribute pizza with our collective monetary gift**.

Please write checks to "**Boys & Girls Clubs of Durham and Orange Counties**." You can mail the check to my PO Box at: **PO Box 995, Hillsborough, NC 27278**. It would be amazing to present a large blessing to these hardworking staffers and show they have the support of our team and of Republicans in our community. If you would like to join me on June 7th, please indicate that in the volunteer link below.

clean_body: I have an idea. | | | | | | | Dear Peter, I want to ask for your help in showing support for a very special ministry in Durham county. I have been volunteering since the beginning of this year once a week with the Boys and Girls Club , and the impact I see them making on kids that come from low-income households is immeasurable. I didn't know much about the club before this year. Their "goal is to combat the growing juvenile delinquency problem in the community and ensure that all Club members are on track to graduate from high school with a plan for the future." What I learned quickly is that every child only has to pay $10/year to be a member. The staff at the Club pour their hearts and time into these kids, and most of them come from really broken backgrounds. A lot of the children are from foster or single-parent households. They have been very successful in keeping teenagers engaged and desiring to be there. The club primarily operates using funds raised by donation. I have spent time talking with the staff there and building relationships, and I would like to help our community as a congressional candidate! Will you partner with me in showing this specific community, filled with children who are in a loving nurturing environment, that WE, as Republicans, want to see them thrive? I constantly say that I want to see the life, liberty, and pursuit of happiness to be experienced by all my constituents. I believe that starts with the next generation. I can attest that this club gives these kids the support they need to thrive. They keep up with their grades in school. They assist some of the children during the day by doing remote learning as needed. They talk to the older children about staying off of drugs and prioritizing their futures. It would be so great to be able to SHOW them that Republicans want to see these kids grow and help stop the cycle of poverty in Durham. The Boys and Girls Club has been very gracious to let me come in with a team from Courtney Geels for Congress to present a gift to them. Will you please consider making a donation to this wonderful nonprofit? Contributions made to the Boys and Girls Club ARE tax-deductible, and ALL of this money will go directly to the Boys and Girls Club of Durham. Courtney Geels for Congress will purchase pizza for the children on June 7th. Please join me there at 4pm on June 7th wearing your Courtney Geels for Congress shirt and help me distribute pizza with our collective monetary gift. Please write checks to "Boys & Girls Clubs of Durham and Orange Counties." You can mail the check to my PO Box at: PO Box 995, Hillsborough, NC 27278. It would be amazing to present a large blessing to these hardworking staffers and show they have the support of our team and of Republicans in our community. Candidate Comparisons Pt. 4

We’re just weeks away from the June 7th Primary Election - with just 5 days left to register if you haven't already.
You will decide which Republican will represent us in NJ-07, and take on Democrat Tom Malinowski this November. Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.

clean_body: Hello, My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day. My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close. Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks. The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you. Dear Friend, Please see Richard’s press release he sent out today on price fixing. [If you can chip in a contribution to help get Richard’s message out to the voters, it will be greatly appreciated! Every dollar makes a difference.](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=031aff86dd&e=8914b14955) Thank you, -Team Painter

**For Immediate Release** **Richard Painter today called for the U.S. Department of Justice to open investigations of price fixing by giant meat packing companies in pork, poultry and beef.** Meat prices are sky high in the grocery store. The GOP blames President Biden for inflation. Here’s what is really going on:
* The Trump Justice Department for four years did not enforce antitrust laws, including Section 1 of the Sherman Act, a criminal statute with lengthy prison terms for corporate executives who engage in price fixing.
* Federal prosecutors finally brought criminal charges against price fixing executives in the poultry industry.
* Federal civil lawsuits are pending against the largest pork packaging companies, including Hormel Foods alleging a price fixing scheme going back to 2009 in violation of Section 1 of the Sherman Act. Two of the defendants, JBS and Chinese owned Smithfield Foods have entered a $102 million settlement agreement, returning some of their pork price fixing profits to consumers, but the other defendants including Hormel Foods refuse to settle the lawsuit or admit to wrongdoing.
* Similar lawsuits have been filed against the beef industry. As in the poultry and pork price fixing litigation, the plaintiffs include wholesalers, grocery chains and sandwich restaurants such as Subway and Jimmy Johns. These businesses all pass the higher cost of meat on to consumers, so the real victim of meat packers’ price fixing is the American consumer.
* Farmers also are victims of price fixing by meat packers. Just yesterday, May 11 President Biden said in a speech in Kankakee, Illinois: “Only four big companies, by the way, control more than half the markets for beef, pork, and poultry. Without meaningful competition, our farmers and ranchers have to pay whatever the four big retailers are saying they’ll pay for their chickens, their hogs, and their cattle. These big companies can use their position as middlemen to overcharge grocery stores and, ultimately, families.”
* The pork packing monopolists are among the worst offenders. As President Biden said yesterday in his speech: “Fifty years ago, hog farmers got 40 to 60 cents for each dollar the family spent raising that hog. Today, it’s about 19 cents. And as big companies made massive profits, the prices you see at the grocery stores have gone up and the prices farmers receive has gone down. This reflects a market distorted by the lack of competition.”

Richard Painter has been writing, speaking, and teaching about business ethics since 1993. Section 307 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 is based on language Richard proposed to Congress requiring lawyers for corporations to report illegal conduct, including price fixing, up the ladder to corporate boards of directors. CEOs, directors, and senior officers of meat packing companies must have known about price fixing schemes. Congress needs to fix our antitrust laws so they are easier to enforce and price fixing corporate officers are held personally responsible for ripping off American consumers and farmers. Richard recognizes that persons and corporations are innocent until proven guilty. However, the evidence in these cases - including the $102 million JBS/Smithfield pork price fixing settlement -- is sufficiently strong that the Justice Department should expand its criminal investigation of the poultry industry to include pork and beef. Congress also should hold hearings and subpoena witnesses and documents. Eating at Subway or Jimmy Johns should not be a luxury just for the wealthy. The time to defend American consumers and farmers against price fixing in food, gasoline, and other goods, is NOW. Richard Painter is a business ethics professor, not a corporate CEO, he’s on the side of the consumer, and he’s determined to go to Congress to get this done.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Stand for those with no voice
body:
|
---
| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [[](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJx9UE1rxCAQ_TXJLSExxrCHHBaW3LaUUuhRRh2zUj-CGvr3a7It9FQYBsZ5783zqVlJBb2szUw6QrqxP9pILy0ZJ0ZAMKQwSdSioh1YjLmNuO3CGgk-Q_rUIUpsZXD1Y4YLGySCGKi4dJRqNnaCCjXRkfWTolP9ced3MNb49QUczjFrHhP3wEGaxhqNfGx60hDCSW3nR85bqoZrRZZSQWuMqS28eNyWIfoy5-CxDXEtgC2GU6NJGTI69PkgDsueHU9hLzar4VZAaUOZi4WKsGPlUJndlRW6Yu3nUYLbwKz-yeCntT-yT0zw-ZiG2-u1eXtfmt8A6zir7ctYaxKbSmzrIXxGlP_98jeCOYRl)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJx9UE1rxCAQ_TXJLSExxrCHHBaW3LaUUuhRRh2zUj-CGvr3a7It9FQYBsZ5783zqVlJBb2szUw6QrqxP9pILy0ZJ0ZAMKQwSdSioh1YjLmNuO3CGgk-Q_rUIUpsZXD1Y4YLGySCGKi4dJRqNnaCCjXRkfWTolP9ced3MNb49QUczjFrHhP3wEGaxhqNfGx60hDCSW3nR85bqoZrRZZSQWuMqS28eNyWIfoy5-CxDXEtgC2GU6NJGTI69PkgDsueHU9hLzar4VZAaUOZi4WKsGPlUJndlRW6Yu3nUYLbwKz-yeCntT-yT0zw-ZiG2-u1eXtfmt8A6zir7ctYaxKbSmzrIXxGlP_98jeCOYRl) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJx9UE1rxCAQ_TXJLSExxrCHHBaW3LaUUuhRRh2zUj-CGvr3a7It9FQYBsZ5783zqVlJBb2szUw6QrqxP9pILy0ZJ0ZAMKQwSdSioh1YjLmNuO3CGgk-Q_rUIUpsZXD1Y4YLGySCGKi4dJRqNnaCCjXRkfWTolP9ced3MNb49QUczjFrHhP3wEGaxhqNfGx60hDCSW3nR85bqoZrRZZSQWuMqS28eNyWIfoy5-CxDXEtgC2GU6NJGTI69PkgDsueHU9hLzar4VZAaUOZi4WKsGPlUJndlRW6Yu3nUYLbwKz-yeCntT-yT0zw-ZiG2-u1eXtfmt8A6zir7ctYaxKbSmzrIXxGlP_98jeCOYRl) Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

clean_body: Join the Faith and Freedom Summit with David Barton and Vicky Hartzler| | | | | | Friend, On May 27th, join Congresswoman Vicky Hartzler and David Barton at the Faith and Freedom Summit! Congresswoman Vicky Hartzler is teaming up with historian and best-selling author David Barton. Barton is the founder of WallBuilders, a national, pro-family organization that presents America’s forgotten history and heroes with an emphasis on our constitutional heritage. During this one-day event, David will help us to explore Faith and Freedom within the United States alongside Congresswoman Vicky Hartzler. WallBuilders is an organization dedicated to presenting America’s forgotten history and heroes, with an emphasis on the moral, religious, and constitutional foundation on which America was built – a foundation which, in recent years, has been seriously attacked and undermined. Tickets are FREE, but space is limited! RSVP today to make sure you get registered! Click this link or the button below: . With the right to an abortion under attack, this race is more important than ever before.
#
Hi, it's Katie Porter.
Erica Smith’s primary election is in just 5 days. [**Anything you can give today will immediately help Erica win her race and join me in Congress to fight for Americans’ right to a safe and legal abortion.**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/54653?refcode=em20220512-1182&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1182%2E3698%2EOe-JVj)

clean_body: Every single time Republicans have attacked our rights, I’ve fought back. | | , Republicans have been preparing for the fall of Roe v. Wade for years. Here in SC, Gov. McMaster and GOP lawmakers have prioritized divisive schemes to strip women of our rights, from introducing trigger laws that would ban all abortions when Roe is overturned, to making women jump through egregious hoops to gain access to abortion services. | Every single time Republicans have attacked our rights, I've fought back. In 2015, I introduced the Viagra Bill to expose the hypocrisy of the GOP's war on women. When SC Republicans passed the "Fetal Heartbeat" bill (effectively banning abortions at 6-weeks of pregnancy), I introduced the Pro-Birth Accountability Act, a groundbreaking proposal that requires the state to help cover costs associated with pregnancy, childbirth, and child-rearing -- from conception to college. My record of fiercely defending women's right to choose is exactly what we need at this moment, and our June 14th Democratic Primary is now the biggest fight for women's rights in South Carolina. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: I've spent my career fighting to protect the right to choose, and as your Governor, you can count on me to continue to support reproductive freedom and block any restrictive anti-abortion bills. Thank you for standing with me, Mia About Senator Mia McLeod: Senator Mia McLeod is a working mom, small business owner, and seventh-generation South Carolinian from Bennettsville, South Carolina. subject: Update: the state of OUR race and why we need YOU!
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress
body:
#
Hi friends —
We wanted to provide a quick update on the state of our race.
As a reminder, the New York State Congressional maps were recently thrown out, completely changing the course of this primary. Here’s some new information for you:
* The primary date is now scheduled for August 23rd.
* On May 16th, the newly drawn maps will be made available to the public.
* They won’t be finalized until May 20th, at which time we’ll know exactly what the new NY-3 looks like. We’ll also learn what period of time we have to petition.

**We’ll be honest – there’s a lot of uncertainty in our race right now. But despite that, Alessandra is still the strongest and most experienced candidate.**
And the reasons Alessandra decided to run for Congress couldn’t be more important given the infuriating news out of Washington. Our country desperately needs stronger Democrats who actually embody the core values of our own party and agenda. Leaders who will fight relentlessly to protect abortion and voting rights, to combat the climate crisis, to expand access to affordable health care, to raise the minimum wage, and so much more.
These issues are supported by a majority of Americans, but we need members of Congress who will actually fight like hell to deliver. This is the type of Representative Alessandra will be, because it’s who she’s been in the State Senate.
We know she has what it takes to win, but the truth is that the changing district lines and the date of our primary being pushed back means that we need to raise even more money than we’d originally projected to organize and win. So please, if you’re able:
[**Make a contribution of $5 or any amount you can afford to Alessandra Biaggi’s campaign for Congress today. Our race has changed significantly in the past weeks, so we’re counting on your support.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biaggi-em-may/?refcode=em220512-1-15&refcode2=769_59515_76GgZP&akid=769%2E59515%2E76GgZP)

We’ll be in touch soon,
– Team Biaggi

body:
| | Alex Walker is the Democrat running against Lauren Boebert in Colorado.

Below is his response to the Supreme Court's leaked opinion on _Roe v. Wade_. While we'd love for you to read it, we understand your time is valuable. [**Will you please click here to split a donation between our campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us defeat Lauren Boebert and the MAGA Machine?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/11581?t=6&akid=2347%2E878179%2EwctC-w)
---
Writing this email makes me sick.

But here goes nothing.

Back in 2016, I was crammed into a friend's tiny apartment for a small dinner party. And I overheard someone say how they were _soo disgusted_ by Donald Trump and _soo disillusioned_ with Hillary Clinton that they were going to throw their vote away for a third party candidate.

Many at the party agreed with her.

Next thing I knew, Donald Trump became our president only to _single-handedly_ create the most conservative Supreme Court in our lifetimes.

Now, that Court is overturning _Roe v. Wade_.

The sacred ruling that told generations of women that they mattered, that they had the power and the right to choose for themselves, and that nobody else can control their bodies. It's about to be wiped away.

And no one is happier than Lauren Boebert.

She can't wait to shut down Planned Parenthood and ban birth control and whatever else is in her evil to-do list.

Look, our primary is next month. And if we send some career politician to fight for us, Lauren Boebert will waltz back into Congress and continue rampaging away our rights.
[**So, we 're asking you directly: Will you please split a donation between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us cut through the noise and give Democrats an actual chance to beat Lauren Boebert?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/11581?t=7&akid=2347%2E878179%2EwctC-w)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Alex Walker and VPP will go through immediately:

Our polling shows that we can win this thing if we can build up our ground-team.

And your support will make sure we have more organizers, field offices, and digital ads than anyone else.

We're counting on you.

Thank you so much for being a part of this fight.

-Alex

body:
This is a huge moment in our fight for single-payer health care in America.
#
Peter, it’s official: **My friend Senator Bernie Sanders just reintroduced Medicare for All in the U.S. Senate!**
I introduced the House version of Medicare for All, H.R. 1976, last year with more than half of the Democratic caucus as co-sponsors. Bernie re-introducing M4A in the Senate is a huge moment in our fight for single-payer health care in America.
[**Will you add your name in support of Medicare for All at this critical moment? Now more than ever we need to show the broad base of public support for Medicare for All across the country:**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13636?t=1&akid=1258%2E420207%2EqTXee9)
**[Add your name »](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13636?t=2&akid=1258%2E420207%2EqTXee9)**
Medicare for All is **_the_****transformative bill** that says in clear, undeniable terms that health care is a human right.
Medicare for All is **_the_****popular, necessary, and urgent solution** to a broken, for-profit health care system that left nearly 90 million Americans uninsured or underinsured during a pandemic.
Medicare for All is **_the_****system** that ensures everyone has the care they need. That’s health care WITH primary care, vision, dental, prescription drugs, mental health, long-term supports and services, and more. It’s health care WITHOUT copays, private insurance premiums, deductibles, and other out-of-pocket costs.
[**The more people sign on to our petition, the more public pressure mounts on members of Congress to support this bill. Take a minute and sign the petition demanding Medicare for All NOW:**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13636?t=3&akid=1258%2E420207%2EqTXee9)
